static_effective_series_resistance.interpretation: effective total series resistance only; no physical decomposition into load/wiring/readout is inferred

electrical_rc_relaxation.topology: series R_l + L plus one passive R||C relaxation element per TES branch

optimization_evaluator: deterministic expected post-analysis ASD; full-record production validation only for each branch winner

fit.loss: band-balanced robust normalized log10(model/measurement) shape residual; equalized broad bands plus high-frequency ramp and broad-band mean-ratio penalty; plus one absolute ASD level anchor at 1 kHz
fit.absolute_asd_calibration_status: unresolved_for_exact_target; diagnostic only unless --absolute-asd-weight is explicitly set > 0

required_transfer_diagnostics.interpretation: H_required < 1 means additional attenuation would be required; H_required > 1 means additional gain would be required. No correction is applied to the optimizer.
required_transfer_diagnostics.known_chain_context: 100 kHz 4th-order mag Bessel, first ADC alias fold, and 10 kHz digital analysis response are already included

source_class_diagnostics.measurement_chain: intrinsic source class -> fixed 100 kHz 4th-order mag Bessel -> first ADC alias fold -> fixed 10 kHz digital analysis response

source_class_transfer_shape_diagnostics.sensitivity_definition: p_j(f) = source-class j PSD / total PSD; d log ASD_normalized(f) / d log ASD_j = p_j(f) - p_j(1 kHz)

johnson_source_scale_diagnostics.scale_semantics: ASD_J -> s_J * ASD_J; PSD_J -> s_J^2 * PSD_J

effective_series_resistance_diagnostics.interpretation_guardrail: R_series_eff is the total effective series resistance required by the reduced noise model. It is not a decomposition into physical load, wiring, SQUID-input, or other hardware resistances.

hanging_thermal_body_sweep_diagnostics.held_fixed: all parameters of the static-series best fit
hanging_thermal_body_sweep_diagnostics.interpretation_guardrail: This grid only tests whether one small TES-attached thermal structure can move the residual in the desired direction. It is not evidence that a physical hanging body exists and its parameters are not admitted to the production optimizer.

series_thermalization_node_sweep_diagnos.held_fixed: all parameters of the static-series best fit
series_thermalization_node_sweep_diagnos.interpretation_guardrail: This screen preserves the fitted DC TES--Stycast conductance and tests only an added series thermal time scale.  A positive result would motivate a constrained physical model; it is not evidence that a distinct physical interfacial body exists.

johnson_beta_audit.note: This audit records the repository convention and code-path parity; it does not by itself establish the experimental beta convention.
